channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Carter Bryant | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Carter Bryant from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stephon Castle on Carter Bryant
item.description:
Steph Castle on Carter Bryant:

“For him to be a rookie and come in and there's no dropoff defensively. That alone says a lot. For him to come in and give us a breather and defensive rebound for us and try and make minimal mistakes is big because we need those minutes. In the playoffs, every possession matters. So, when he's doing that and making it tough on (SGA) and tiring him out, in the long run, it definitely helps.”

Stephon Castle on Carter Bryant, May 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Harrison Barnes on Carter Bryant
item.description:
Spurs forward Harrison Barnes told Andscape.

“The finishing package. The way he is able to be a point guard. To get a start today, seven steals; you just can’t teach that. But off the court, he’s a kid, one thousand percent. “He and [rookie forward] Carter Bryant are about the same age. And sometimes you might think Carter is the bigger brother. But I love Dylan. That is what allows him to be himself. He’s confident in who he is. He’s young. But I don’t think that his age makes him hesitant at all. He steps in the moment and embraces it.”

Harrison Barnes on Carter Bryant, May 20, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Cooper Flagg on Carter Bryant
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Cooper Flagg on how Carter Bryant hounded him:

“He is really lengthy. He plays really good defense. I mean, he didn't look tired at all the whole game. He was picking me up 94. I was definitely feeling a little bit gassed, but he was just there playing great defense the whole way, physical.”

Cooper Flagg on Carter Bryant, Jul 12, 2025. Source: Bluesky.
